default.description: No capabilities file existed in this project before this: Tauri v2's ACL denies every plugin command by default without one. Confirmed live against a real running build -- `plugin:shell|open` failed with "not allowed by ACL", meaning the update banner's Download link could never open anything, on desktop or Android. Custom app-defined #[tauri::command]s (printing, LAN discovery, etc.) are unaffected -- the ACL only gates plugin-namespaced commands. Applies to both platforms since the shell plugin is registered unconditionally.

desktop-updater.description: Windows-only: the updater and process plugins are never registered on mobile (see lib.rs's #[cfg(windows)] gate), so their permissions are scoped the same way here. Confirmed live against a real running build -- `plugin:updater|check` ALSO failed with "not allowed by ACL" with no capabilities file present, meaning the silent desktop auto-updater had never actually completed a real check through its own code path before this.

mobile-updater.description: Android-only: grants the custom apk-updater plugin (packages/tauri-plugin-apk-updater), which downloads an update .apk through DownloadManager and hands it to the system install prompt -- Android's equivalent of the Windows updater's desktop-updater capability.
